description: Getting and making things for your resident's home, one action at a time: gather (once round the garden, or a material from the wilds: timber or sticks at the woodlot, stone, clay or sand at the quarry, flax, wool or flowers at the meadow, iron, tin or copper at the scrapyard), make (something from materials at the bench, like an armchair or planks, or at a neighbour's table with them), cook (a dish at home; three a day), bake (bread, a cake or a tart, from the garden in season), plant (one plant in the garden, grown from the pack or bought). Each takes real minutes, and check recipes, check menu and check materials say what's possible. Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. A plant to buy or grow says what it costs and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to that cost in this chat. It never spends glow, and nothing is taken away. Before making, call check (what: recipe) with a name to see what it takes.

action.description: What to do: gather, make, cook, bake or plant.

confirm.description: Optional, plant: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.

dish.description: cook and bake: the dish, like soup, pancakes, bread or apple cake.

line.description: Optional, make, cook, bake and plant: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

own_idea.description: Optional, make, cook, bake and plant: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

thing.description: make: what to make, like armchair or 6 planks.

what.description: Optional, gather: a material, like timber. Left out, once round the garden (once a day).

with.description: Optional, make: a neighbour to make it with, at their table, like Mira.

name: provide
title: Get and make things
